_note: One calibration of record (sprint 029 ticket 006, TL-02/TL-11). camlink.py loads this file and registers a mount with the aprilcam daemon ONLY on an explicit --register call; robotlink.py's radio_address() reads/derives from it. mount_yaw_residual_deg is the sub-degree PHYSICAL mount skew ONLY -- the fixed +90 deg AprilCam front-edge-to-hat convention (.claude/rules/tag-yaw-is-the-front-edge-not-the-hat.md) is never stored here; it is added back in code, once, by camlink.mount_yaw_rad() (for daemon registration) and field.robot_heading_from_tag_yaw() (for a raw, unregistered tag reading).

field._note: Fixed field furniture, not a robot -- not subject to the TL-02 remount-overwrite hazard. Height-only mount (drives camera parallax correction only; no forward direction, so no yaw convention applies). Register once per daemon session with `camlink.py --register field`. Tag 10 sits over the NW dot (-50, 30), tag 11 over the SW dot (-50, -30) -- permanent ground truth in every frame.

vevov._radio_note: MEASURED 2026-08-30 (.claude/rules/playfield-testing.md fleet table); also the base-5 name-derived pair (make_deploy.derive_radio_from_name('vevov')) -- kept explicit here since this is the file robotlink.radio_address() reads first.
vevov._lever_note: Tag 53 relative to the centre of rotation, in the TAG frame, as the camera REPORTS it (parallax-dilated, so it is applied to raw positions without dividing by parallax_k). Mean of two 4x90 deg in-place pivot solves, least squares over tag = centre + R(yaw)*lever: pass1 (+90s) (0.287,-2.638) rms 1.08 mm, pass2 (-90s) (0.167,-2.816) rms 1.18 mm; implied centres per pose agree to +-0.2 cm. captures/vevov-cal-20260902/02-levercal-pass1.txt, 03-levercal-pass2.txt. True (undilated) lever is about 2.44 cm behind the centre. Previous plate position (6.38 cm behind) is obsolete.
vevov._parallax_note: The tag rides 12.0 cm above the field, so the camera reports every DISPLACEMENT scaled by this about its own nadir. Divide any camera distance by it for truth. MEASURED 2026-09-02 over two opposing 50 cm legs: 1.1167 and 1.1217 (captures/vevov-cal-20260902/04-probe-50cm.txt); the previous 1.1167 at 11.8 cm implies a camera height of ~113 cm, which predicts 1.1189 at 12.0 cm -- consistent. NOTE the daemon's stored camera_position.height_cm is 128.23, which disagrees with the ~113 cm the parallax measures; that is why this tool uses the raw tag plus its own k rather than a daemon mount_z.
vevov._mount_note: mount_x/y_cm: tag 53 relative to the centre of rotation in the ROBOT frame for daemon registration, undilated -- master's 2026-09-02 lever solve puts the tag 2.727 cm behind as the camera reports it (parallax-dilated by 1.1192), i.e. ~2.44 cm true; y from the 0.227 cm lateral term. UNVERIFIED as a daemon registration (the solve was made for the raw-tag + lever_cm path below); re-fit with camlink --register + a pivot triple before trusting the registered centre to better than 1 cm.

tovez._provenance: mount_yaw_residual_deg 0.0: the plate is mounted on the fleet convention (tag arrow = robot front; stakeholder 2026-09-04, confirmed on the camera). A 180 deg residual was recorded earlier the same day from captures/bench-acceptance-029-20260904d/heading-probe.log (tag moved at bearing +11 deg while the daemon reported -166 deg) and was WRONG: the robot was driving BACKWARDS -- the firmware carried vevov's motor mapping (left{1,-1}/right{2,+1}) and tovez is wired left=port 2 (-1), right=port 1 (+1); swap+invert reverses travel and leaves rotation alone, which is exactly why pivots passed and straights went the other way. Fixed by baking radio-robot-lib tovez.json geometry.firmware_bake.motors via make_deploy.py _inject_motors(). mount_x_cm -4.1 (tag BEHIND the centre) per radio-robot-lib vision.tag_offset_x -41 mm, magnitude still UNVERIFIED here. Lesson: a residual near +-180 or +-90 is never a plate finding until a probe move has been checked against the ARROW, not against the daemon's heading.
tovez._radio_note: No explicit override -- radio_address('tovez') falls through to make_deploy.derive_radio_from_name('tovez') = (55, 108), matching the MEASURED fleet table in .claude/rules/playfield-testing.md (2026-08-30).
tovez._lever_parallax_note: parallax_k = 1.0 because the daemon already applies the tag-height (mount_z_cm = 11.3) parallax correction for a REGISTERED tag (aprilcam list_tag_parameters reports mount_z_applied: true for tag 52), so a tool dividing by a parallax factor on top of that corrects twice. MEASURED tovez 2026-09-04, captures/bench-acceptance-029-20260904d/heading-probe.log: a 5 cm MOVE_X displaced the daemon-reported (registered) tag position by 4.87 cm -- i.e. already undilated; the old k=1.1167 borrowed from vevov made every dance drive read ~12 % short (field-dance-refit-run1/2.log: 17.6 cm for 20, 35.3 cm for 40 = 20/1.1167, 40/1.1167). vevov's entry still needs its k because tag 53 is registered with mount_z 0 -- see clasi/issues/parallax-k-and-registered-mount-z-correct-twice.md. lever_cm=[0,0] remains a PLACEHOLDER (harmless for the dance: turn() reads heading deltas, drive() differences two poses at one heading).
